item.title: Parliamentary Constituencies 1918 (Ireland — all-island) source files
item.subtitle: Parliamentary Constituencies / Parlconst.org
item.description: All-Ireland Westminster parliamentary constituencies after the 1918 Representation of the People Act. 107 constituencies covering the whole island, in use for the December 1918 General Election. Built by dissolving parlconst's per-section boundary mosaics (105–111 ROI + the parlconst NI 1918 layer).
